external_entities.name: User
external_entities.description: Person uploading spreadsheets, editing the canvas, and exporting schema.

external_entities.name: Filesystem
external_entities.description: Local disk for .dfd.json project files and uploaded spreadsheets.

external_entities.name: LLM Service
external_entities.description: Claude/GPT — assists with proposal generation (planned, not wired).

processes.name: Parse Source File
processes.description: Excel/CSV parsers in backend/parsers/ extract column types into SourceTableModel.

processes.name: Build PenFile
processes.description: pen_builder.build_pen_file() creates initial Entities + Attributes from sources.

processes.name: Generate Proposals
processes.description: proposals.py detects M2M splits, lookup tables, cross-sheet FKs.

processes.name: Apply Typed Operations
processes.description: ops_service.apply_op() routes typed commands to ERD/DFD/Layout handlers.

processes.name: Validate Schema
processes.description: sync_engine.validate() checks for blocking conflicts before commit.

processes.name: Export Artifacts
processes.description: generators/sql.py, dbml.py, mermaid.py emit downloadable schema files.

proposals.title: Decompose 'Apply Typed Operations' into a Level 1 DFD?
proposals.question: Process 4.0 fans out to ERD ops, DFD ops, and Layout ops. Decompose into a child diagram?

proposals.title: Wire LLM service into proposal generation?
proposals.question: Currently proposals are heuristic. Should an LLM be added as an external entity that augments process 3.0?
